why_an_image: The scanned page's text layer carries none of the echoed numbers (pdftotext finds no 47.0 or 590 on PDF pp. 121-122), so the page image is the receipt and the values were read by eye.

read.where: Appendix III, 'ECHO PRINT (LIST-DIRECTED OUTPUT) OF INPUT VALUES', NUMDRT(I),EMTQPM(I),EMTQCO(I),EMTQH(I),EMTQR(I) FOR I = 1
read.units: EMTQPM grams per second, total particulate matter of any size class (manual, Appendix I, EMTQPM: 'emission rates in grams per second'); EMTQH megawatts ('total sensible heat emission rate in megawatts')
